record.body:
## Rationale

Plan review is the go or no-go. The reviewer needs the size of the phase, whether it will stop and wait, and whether parallel tasks touch the same files. A coarse size is enough. The dashboard already shows real elapsed time once a task is running.

## Counter-argument

A clock time, a confidence, and a risk score look more precise. They get invented, then ignored, and they do not change the plan beyond what size, stops, and collisions already say.

payload.alternatives: clock-time estimate and risk scores; no run facts beyond the task list
payload.choice: The phase body records size as one sitting or more, the human stops, and the areas parallel tasks share.

record.subject: phase-run-facts
